style: Fast propulsive cinematic folk-orchestral battle as sparks fly from old copper lines. Syncopated low string and analog bass ostinato, pounding taiko and frame drums, spiccato violins, hammered dulcimer and a fiery solo violin melody answered by bold brass. Energetic, bright and adventurous, acoustic warmth with electronic drive. Entirely instrumental: empty vocal part, no lyrics, singing, choir, humming or speech. Evolving instrumental arrangement, clear melodic development, spacious ending. Dm, 130 BPM.
